vulns.title: SQL injection in the SQL lab (raw() with string-concatenated credentials)
vulns.notes: sql_query built by string concatenation of POST 'name'/'pass', passed to login.objects.raw(). View is NOT @csrf_exempt, so runtime detection needs a CSRF token + an authenticated session.

vulns.title: SQL injection in the A03 injection lab (raw() with concatenated input)
vulns.notes: Same raw()-concatenation pattern as PG01 against sql_lab_table. View IS @csrf_exempt; still requires an authenticated session.

vulns.title: Reflected XSS in the XSS lab (q reflected via a |safe template)
vulns.notes: GET 'q' is rendered into Lab/XSS/xss_lab.html, which uses the |safe filter (autoescaping bypassed). Reflected on the branch where no company matches. Requires an authenticated session.

vulns.title: OS command injection in the command-injection lab (subprocess shell=True)
vulns.notes: POST 'domain' is string-formatted into an nslookup/dig command run with subprocess.Popen(shell=True). The replace('https://www.','') is not a sanitiser. View IS @csrf_exempt; requires an authenticated session.

vulns.title: Hard-coded Django SECRET_KEY in settings
vulns.notes: SECRET_KEY assigned a literal string in settings.py (not read from the environment). Code-only.

vulns.title: Debug mode enabled (DEBUG = True) -> verbose error pages
vulns.notes: UNCERTAIN runtime manifestation: settings.py sets DEBUG = True (verified in source), so Django returns verbose tracebacks on errors (e.g. the /500error route raises deliberately). Confirm against a live instance; environment overrides could disable it.

vulns.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header (host-wide)
vulns.notes: UNCERTAIN runtime manifestation: no CSP middleware or django-csp in requirements, so responses are expected to lack a Content-Security-Policy header. Django's default middleware does set X-Frame-Options, so clickjacking protection is present. Confirm header absence against a live instance.
